solver_sql: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.best_of) as avg_best_of, AVG(m.winner_age) as avg_winner_age FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_best_of) as avg_best_of, AVG(avg_winner_age) as avg_winner_age FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_winner_age) as overall_avg FROM step2) SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_best_of, step2.avg_winner_age, step2.avg_winner_age / step3.overall_avg FROM step2 CROSS JOIN step3 WHERE step3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

SELECT loser_ioc, COUNT(*) as A, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY loser_ioc)) as ratio_A_T, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY loser_ioc)) as ratio_A_B FROM matches GROUP BY loser_ioc

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as col3, AVG(CAST(m.loser_age - m.winner_age AS FLOAT)) as col4 FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(step1.col3) as col1 FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.col1, step1.col2, step1.col3, step1.col4, step1.col3 - step2.col1 as col5 FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2), step4 AS (SELECT step3.col2, AVG(step3.col3) as col2, AVG(step3.col4) as col3, AVG(step3.col5) as col4 FROM step3 GROUP BY step3.col2) SELECT AVG(col2), AVG(col3), AVG(col4) FROM step4

WITH ranking_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as C FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(C) as T FROM ranking_counts), with_ratios AS (SELECT rc.player_id, rc.C, CAST(rc.C AS FLOAT) / ts.T as R FROM ranking_counts rc, total_sum ts), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(R) as M FROM with_ratios), filtered AS (SELECT wr.player_id, wr.C, wr.R, wr.C - ar.M as C_minus_M FROM with_ratios wr, avg_ratio ar WHERE wr.C > ar.M) SELECT player_id, C, R, C_minus_M FROM filtered ORDER BY C_minus_M DESC, player_id LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.best_of) as avg_best_of, AVG(m.winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT s1.hand, AVG(s1.avg_best_of) as avg_of_avg_best_of, AVG(s1.avg_winner_ht) as avg_of_avg_ht FROM step1 s1 GROUP BY s1.hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_of_avg_best_of) as M FROM step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.hand, s2.avg_of_avg_best_of, s2.avg_of_avg_ht, s2.avg_of_avg_best_of - s3.M as diff FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s2.avg_of_avg_best_of > s3.M) SELECT AVG(s4.avg_of_avg_best_of) as avg_col2, AVG(s4.avg_of_avg_ht) as avg_col3, AVG(s4.diff) as avg_col4 FROM step4 s4

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(s1.avg_draw) as M FROM step1 s1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.avg_draw, s1.avg_draw / s2.M as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(s3.ratio) as M FROM step3 s3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.avg_draw, s3.ratio, s3.avg_draw - s4.M as diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s3.avg_draw > s4.M) SELECT AVG(s5.avg_draw), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT tourney_level, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY tourney_level), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(s1.cnt) as total FROM step1 s1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.tourney_level, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS FLOAT) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(s3.ratio) as M FROM step3 s3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.tourney_level, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.M as diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s3.cnt > s4.M) SELECT SUM(s5.cnt), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(s1.cnt) as total FROM step1 s1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS FLOAT) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(s3.ratio) as M FROM step3 s3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.loser_id, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.M as diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s3.cnt > s4.M) SELECT AVG(s5.cnt), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_ioc, AVG(winner_rank_points) as avg_points FROM matches GROUP BY winner_ioc), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(s1.avg_points) as M FROM step1 s1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_ioc, s1.avg_points, s1.avg_points / s2.M as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(s3.ratio) as M FROM step3 s3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_ioc, s3.avg_points, s3.ratio, s3.avg_points - s4.M as diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s3.ratio > s4.M) SELECT AVG(s5.avg_points), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT s1.hand, AVG(s1.avg_draw) as avg_col FROM step1 s1 GROUP BY s1.hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_col) as M FROM step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.hand, s2.avg_col, s2.avg_col - s3.M as diff FROM step2 s2, step3 s3), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_col) as M FROM step4 s4), final AS (SELECT s4.hand, s4.avg_col, s4.diff, s4.avg_col - s5.M as final_diff FROM step4 s4, step5 s5 WHERE s4.avg_col > s5.M) SELECT f.hand, f.avg_col, f.diff, f.final_diff FROM final f

SELECT s4.loser_hand, s4.hand_avg_draw, s4.ratio, s4.hand_avg_draw / s5.avg_hand_draw as final_ratio FROM (WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw_by_player FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND draw_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_draw_by_player) as hand_avg_draw FROM step1 GROUP BY loser_hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(hand_avg_draw) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.loser_hand, s2.hand_avg_draw, s2.hand_avg_draw / s3.overall_avg as ratio FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(hand_avg_draw) as avg_hand_draw FROM step4) SELECT s4.loser_hand, s4.hand_avg_draw, s4.ratio, s5.avg_hand_draw FROM step4 s4, step5 s5) s4, (WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw_by_player FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND draw_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(avg_draw_by_player) as hand_avg_draw FROM step1 GROUP BY loser_hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(hand_avg_draw) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.loser_hand, s2.hand_avg_draw, s2.hand_avg_draw / s3.overall_avg as ratio FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(hand_avg_draw) as avg_hand_draw FROM step4) SELECT s4.loser_hand, s4.hand_avg_draw, s4.ratio, s5.avg_hand_draw FROM step4 s4, step5 s5) s5

WITH winner_stats AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(winner_age) as avg_winner_age, AVG(loser_rank_points / NULLIF(winner_rank_points, 0)) as rank_ratio_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_age IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points > 0 GROUP BY winner_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rank_ratio_avg) as overall_rank_ratio FROM winner_stats) SELECT ws.winner_id, ws.avg_winner_age, ws.rank_ratio_avg, ws.rank_ratio_avg - oa.overall_rank_ratio as diff_from_overall FROM winner_stats ws, overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_rank_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH groups AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN m.loser_ht > 0 THEN CAST(m.loser_ht - m.winner_ht AS FLOAT) / m.loser_ht ELSE NULL END) as D FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), hand_avgs AS (SELECT hand, AVG(D) as H FROM groups GROUP BY hand) SELECT groups.winner_id, groups.hand, groups.D, groups.D - hand_avgs.H as diff FROM groups INNER JOIN hand_avgs ON groups.hand = hand_avgs.hand ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_age IS NOT NULL AND winner_age IS NOT NULL THEN loser_age - winner_age END) as avg_age_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL THEN loser_ht - winner_ht END) as avg_height_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL THEN loser_ht - winner_ht END) - (SELECT AVG(avg_height_diff) FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL THEN loser_ht - winner_ht END) as avg_height_diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand) WHERE avg_height_diff IS NOT NULL) as height_diff_from_G FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand

WITH hand_stats AS (SELECT p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL THEN loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points END) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand), hand_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rank_diff) as G FROM hand_stats WHERE avg_rank_diff IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.hand, AVG(CASE WHEN winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND loser_ht > 0 THEN (winner_ht - loser_ht) * 1.0 / loser_ht END) as avg_relative_height, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL THEN loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points END) as avg_rank_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL THEN loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points END) - (SELECT G FROM hand_average) as rank_diff_from_G FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL THEN loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points END) > (SELECT G FROM hand_average)
SELECT AVG(P), AVG(P_minus_G) FROM filtered

WITH player_hand_stats AS (SELECT p.hand, m.winner_id, AVG(m.loser_ht - m.winner_ht) as avg_ht_diff, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.hand, m.winner_id), hand_stats AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_ht_diff) as avg_ht_diff, AVG(avg_rank_diff) as avg_rank_diff FROM player_hand_stats GROUP BY hand), overall_ht AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ht_diff) as overall_ht FROM hand_stats) SELECT hs.hand, hs.avg_ht_diff, hs.avg_rank_diff, (hs.avg_ht_diff - oh.overall_ht) as ht_diff FROM hand_stats hs, overall_ht oh WHERE hs.avg_ht_diff > oh.overall_ht

WITH hand_stats AS (SELECT winner_hand, AVG(winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rank_pts, AVG(loser_ht - winner_ht) as avg_height_diff FROM matches WHERE winner_hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_hand), overall_height_diff AS (SELECT AVG(avg_height_diff) as overall_avg FROM hand_stats WHERE avg_height_diff IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT h.avg_winner_rank_pts, h.avg_height_diff, o.overall_avg, h.avg_height_diff - o.overall_avg as diff FROM hand_stats h, overall_height_diff o WHERE h.avg_height_diff > o.overall_avg) SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_winner_rank_pts), 2) as result1, ROUND(AVG(avg_height_diff), 2) as result2, ROUND(AVG(diff), 2) as result3 FROM filtered

WITH level_stats AS (SELECT tourney_level, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff FROM matches WHERE tourney_level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tourney_level), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as overall FROM level_stats WHERE avg_diff IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT l.avg_diff, o.overall, l.avg_diff - o.overall as diff FROM level_stats l, overall_avg o WHERE l.avg_diff > o.overall) SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_diff), 2) as result1, ROUND(AVG(diff), 2) as result2 FROM filtered

WITH player_stats AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(CAST(best_of AS FLOAT)) as P, AVG(CAST(loser_rank_points AS FLOAT) / CAST(winner_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as R FROM matches WHERE loser_id IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points > 0 AND winner_rank_points > 0 GROUP BY loser_id), overall_M AS (SELECT AVG(R) as M FROM player_stats WHERE R IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT p.P, p.R, o.M, p.R - o.M as D FROM player_stats p, overall_M o WHERE p.R > o.M) SELECT ROUND(AVG(P), 4) as result1, ROUND(AVG(R), 4) as result2, ROUND(AVG(D), 4) as result3 FROM filtered

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.best_of) as avg_best_of, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff FROM matches m INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_best_of) as avg_col3, AVG(avg_rank_diff) as avg_col4 FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_col3) as avg_best_of_all FROM step2) SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_col3, step2.avg_col4, step2.avg_col3 / step3.avg_best_of_all as ratio FROM step2, step3 WHERE step3.avg_best_of_all IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, winner_hand, AVG(CASE WHEN winner_age > 0 THEN (CAST(loser_age AS FLOAT) - CAST(winner_age AS FLOAT)) / CAST(winner_age AS FLOAT) END) as age_ratio_avg, AVG(CAST(loser_rank_points AS FLOAT) - CAST(winner_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as rank_points_avg FROM matches WHERE winner_hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id, winner_hand), step2 AS (SELECT winner_hand, AVG(age_ratio_avg) as hand_age_ratio_avg, AVG(rank_points_avg) as hand_rank_points_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY winner_hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(hand_age_ratio_avg) as global_age_ratio_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.winner_hand, step2.hand_age_ratio_avg, step2.hand_rank_points_avg, step2.hand_age_ratio_avg - step3.global_age_ratio_avg as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.hand_age_ratio_avg > step3.global_age_ratio_avg) SELECT AVG(hand_age_ratio_avg) as avg_age_ratio, AVG(hand_rank_points_avg) as avg_rank_points, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step4

WITH hand_stats AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(CAST(winner_rank_points AS FLOAT) / CAST(loser_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as X FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points > 0 AND winner_rank_points > 0 GROUP BY loser_hand), overall_Y AS (SELECT AVG(X) as Y FROM hand_stats WHERE X IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT h.loser_hand, h.X, h.X - o.Y as Z FROM hand_stats h, overall_Y o WHERE h.X > o.Y), W_calc AS (SELECT AVG(X) as W FROM filtered) SELECT filtered.loser_hand, ROUND(filtered.X, 4), ROUND(filtered.Z, 4), ROUND(filtered.X - W_calc.W, 4) FROM filtered, W_calc

WITH player_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as C FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), T_calc AS (SELECT SUM(C) as T FROM player_counts WHERE C IS NOT NULL), S_calc AS (SELECT player_id, CAST(C AS FLOAT) / T_calc.T as S, C FROM player_counts, T_calc), A_calc AS (SELECT AVG(S) as A FROM S_calc WHERE S IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT S_calc.player_id, S_calc.S, S_calc.C, A_calc.A, S_calc.S - A_calc.A as D FROM S_calc, A_calc WHERE S_calc.S > A_calc.A) SELECT ROUND(SUM(C), 0) as sum_C, ROUND(AVG(S), 6) as avg_S, ROUND(AVG(D), 6) as avg_D FROM filtered

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, loser_hand, AVG(draw_size) as V FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id, loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(V) as M FROM step1 WHERE V IS NOT NULL), step3 AS (SELECT step1.loser_id, step1.loser_hand, step1.V, step1.V - step2.M as D FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(D) as H FROM step3 GROUP BY loser_hand), step5 AS (SELECT step3.loser_id, step3.loser_hand, step3.V, step3.D, step3.D - step4.H as E FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step3.loser_hand = step4.loser_hand WHERE step3.D > step4.H) SELECT ROUND(AVG(V), 4) as result1, ROUND(AVG(D), 4) as result2, ROUND(AVG(E), 4) as result3 FROM step5

WITH d_values AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(CAST(loser_rank_points AS FLOAT) - CAST(winner_rank_points AS FLOAT)) as d FROM matches WHERE loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), g_value AS (SELECT AVG(d) as G FROM d_values), above_G AS (SELECT winner_id, d, (d - g_value.G) as e FROM d_values, g_value WHERE d > g_value.G), E_value AS (SELECT AVG(d) as E FROM above_G), above_E AS (SELECT winner_id, d, e, (d - E_value.E) as f FROM above_G, E_value WHERE d > E_value.E) SELECT AVG(d) as avg_d, AVG(e) as avg_e, AVG(f) as avg_f FROM above_E
